display_name: 盲信道六种条件后验的输入自洽诊断
description: 固定源盲信道与六类先验，对比平均波形和六个条件波形，用后验、基座自洽及二者乘积分数做输入侧选择。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six class-conditional Gaussian posterior waveforms from frozen blind channel and source prior; input-only F/class-likelihood selection
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth loaded in either training or evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source IQ and frozen F clean pseudo targets for evaluation; no source TX labels, U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source IDs previously explored, pseudo targets only; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed blind estimator and six-component source prior; no training; ground F frozen; DURA comparator only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact blind action sha256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338; source prior sha256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: No training or target selection. Fixed MAP, class self-consistency, product scores and nondeployable candidate union oracle on 384 RX8 source records.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source F pseudo targets not truth, source IDs previously observed in other views, no target test.

rows.method: blind posterior class-conditioned IQ hypotheses with input-only MAP, self-consistency and product selectors
rows.purpose: test candidate diversity and input-only selection without DURA
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 existing prior IDs; fixed 384 RX8 probe
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Frozen blind source estimator and prior, no training or target updates.
Candidate union oracle uses clean F pseudo label unavailable at inference; not deployable and not a general bound.
Class-conditioned priors can hallucinate identity; compare source waveform error.
No TX labels, U_s truth, V or Phase1 test.
